title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: telex release availability, fee and minimum contract rank
content:
## Scope

A telex release is release on surrender of the full set of originals at origin. For Bills of Lading and Transport Documents this card records, by document type, whether a telex release is offered, the fee per telex release, and the lowest service contract tier rank that relieves the telex release fee, where a value of 0 means that no contract relieves it.

## Tier table

| Document type | Telex release offered | Fee per telex release | Lowest contract tier rank relieving the fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | USD 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | USD 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 40.00 | 5 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 55.00 | 5 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 60.00 | 4 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 75.00 | 6 |

## Reading the table

- On the AHL Sea Waybill and the AHL Electronic Bill of Lading a telex release is not offered; their fee of 0.00 and rank of 0 reflect that.
- On the four paper types the rank column gives the lowest contract tier rank that relieves the fee; a higher rank also meets it, a lower rank does not.

## Points of judgement

**What is the telex release fee on an AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading?** USD 60.00 per release, and the lowest relieving contract tier rank is 4.

**Which paper type sets the highest rank?** The AHL Switch Bill of Lading, at rank 6; a contract tier of rank 5 does not reach it.

**Is a telex release possible on an AHL Electronic Bill of Lading?** No; the setting is No.
